experiment.description: Part 28. Naive fusion and V1 PrismFlow on the AIT Log Data Set v2.0, at 300 s network windows, with train and test drawn from DIFFERENT scenarios in both directions. No attack, no corruption, no clone: clean data only.

label_meaning: A window is attack=1 if ANY officially labelled line falls in it, and on both scenarios that label is dominated by one continuously-running DNS exfiltration tool (1,026 of 1,031 attack windows on russellmitchell and 663 of 667 on santos carry only dnsteal-family steps, docs/part26-ait-loader.md sections 0 and 12), so the task is 'was the exfiltration tool running in this window', NOT 'detect an APT' and not 'detect a multi-step intrusion'.
pooling_policy: Direction A and direction B are reported separately and are never pooled, averaged or concatenated. Two directions are two measurements on two different test sets with different prevalences.
seed_meaning: A seed selects the model's parameter initialisation and the minibatch order of every epoch. Train and test are whole scenarios, so a seed cannot redraw or re-partition the data. Every +/- is initialisation-and-batch-order variance, not a spread over independent attacks.

A_rm_to_santos.label: A: train russellmitchell -> test santos
A_rm_to_santos.label_meaning: A window is attack=1 if ANY officially labelled line falls in it, and on both scenarios that label is dominated by one continuously-running DNS exfiltration tool (1,026 of 1,031 attack windows on russellmitchell and 663 of 667 on santos carry only dnsteal-family steps, docs/part26-ait-loader.md sections 0 and 12), so the task is 'was the exfiltration tool running in this window', NOT 'detect an APT' and not 'detect a multi-step intrusion'.

scaler.note: fitted on the training scenario's label_known rows only, refitted per direction, never shared between directions

test_structure.multi_step_definition: attack windows carrying at least one step outside ['attacker', 'dnsteal', 'dnsteal-received', 'dnsteal-dropped', 'exfiltration-service']. The looser count, outside ['attacker', 'dnsteal', 'dnsteal-received', 'dnsteal-dropped'] alone, is n_attack_windows_beyond_dnsteal_family = 4 and differs only by the window holding the exfiltration tool's own SERVICE_START/SERVICE_STOP record.
test_structure.multi_step_caveat: 3 windows of 1152. Any claim about the multi-step intrusion is a handful-of-windows result; no metric in this Part is computed over them.
test_structure.consequence: The block count, not the attack-window count, is the positive class's effective sample size. Every +/- in this Part is a spread over seeds (model initialisation and batch order), NOT over independent attacks.
test_structure.label_meaning: A window is attack=1 if ANY officially labelled line falls in it, and on both scenarios that label is dominated by one continuously-running DNS exfiltration tool (1,026 of 1,031 attack windows on russellmitchell and 663 of 667 on santos carry only dnsteal-family steps, docs/part26-ait-loader.md sections 0 and 12), so the task is 'was the exfiltration tool running in this window', NOT 'detect an APT' and not 'detect a multi-step intrusion'.

missingness.note: no view exceeds 50% missing on this direction's train or test set, so the brief's second configuration was not triggered

paired_prismflow_minus_naive.note: Paired within seed: both systems see the same initialisation draw and the same batch order, so the difference removes that shared variance. n_seeds_favouring_prismflow is reported beside every mean, because a mean near zero with 5/5 seeds on one side is a different statement from a mean near zero with 2/5.

sensor_group_check.reason: the 'network' same-sensor group has 1 member(s) (['suricata']), so no within-group PAIR exists. There is no packet-capture view yet (docs/part27-ait-datacard.md section 9, limitation 9), so the paired difference step 4 asks for has no value to report. Substituting a different pair would answer a different question; the full pair table is reported instead.

B_santos_to_rm.label: B: train santos -> test russellmitchell
